title: Metadata Schema
description: Lifecycle metadata for every knowledge entity within the Forge AI Engineering Intelligence Platform.

data_version.title: Data Version
data_version.description: Version of the underlying knowledge record.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: Indicates whether this record has been verified.

verification_method.title: Verification Method
verification_method.description: Method used to verify this record.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence score representing trust in this metadata.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when this metadata record was created.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating the most recent modification.

last_reviewed.title: Last Reviewed
last_reviewed.description: Timestamp of the most recent human or automated review.

review_notes.title: Review Notes
review_notes.description: Optional notes from reviewers regarding verification or quality.
